evals.prompt:
I've been going back and forth with my team about our database migration strategy. We decided on PostgreSQL over MySQL because of the JSONB support and better partitioning. We're going with Flyway for migrations instead of Liquibase. Schema-first approach, not code-first. Still haven't figured out whether to do a big-bang migration or incremental with dual writes. Also need to decide on connection pooling — PgBouncer vs built-in. Oh and there's a question about whether we partition the audit log table by month or by year.

Save this as a thread.
evals.expected_output: A new thread file in .claude/threads/ with kebab-case filename, YAML frontmatter (status: active, description, summary, last_updated), populated Context section, Decisions table with the 3 decisions (PostgreSQL, Flyway, schema-first), Open Items listing the 3 unresolved questions (migration strategy, connection pooling, partition granularity), and a regenerated INDEX.md.
expectations: A .md file is created in .claude/threads/ with a kebab-case filename
The file has YAML frontmatter with status, summary, description, and last_updated fields
The frontmatter status is 'active'
The Decisions table contains PostgreSQL over MySQL, Flyway over Liquibase, and schema-first approach
The Open Items section lists the unresolved questions about migration strategy, connection pooling, and partition granularity
An INDEX.md file is created or regenerated with the new thread listed
The INDEX.md groups threads by status
